title: Storyline of Eye of the North
wikitext:
{{spoiler|''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North]]''}}
This [[storyline]] article is a recount of the story of ''Guild Wars Eye of the North'', the first expansion of ''Guild Wars'' released in August of 2007. Becoming familiar with key dates in the [[timeline]], the [[History of Tyria]], ''[[Storyline of Prophecies]]'', and [[GW:EN and Now]] will help make certain events in this story clearer.

The story in this expansion revolves around events happening in the continent of [[Tyria]]. The players are cast as the heroes who save Tyria from an ancient threat of fire and stone. In this summary, events will link to their own articles and will only be "re-explained" here as much as needed to enhance readability. 

==Act I: [[The Beginning of the End]]==
Act I takes place after a series of earthquakes in Tyria, Cantha and Elona. It involves the [[Deldrimor]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] fighting against the [[Destroyer]]s, and covers the first part of the Dwarf arc.

During the travel quest from Cantha, Elona or Tyria to the underground passages of those locations, the players encounter [[Ogden Stonehealer]] and [[Vekk]], as well as a horde of Destroyers, and are forced to flee through an [[Asura gate]] into [[Boreal Station]] in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]]. Vekk demolishes the gate to prevent pursuit, and the players encounter [[Jora]], who is unconcerned with them because she is on an important hunt.

Eventually, the players reach the [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]] and encounter the [[Ebon Vanguard]], including [[Gwen]].

==Act II: [[Against the Destroyers]]==
Act II involves three story arcs which can be completed in any order, one involving the [[Asura]], one involving the [[Norn]] and one involving the [[Charr]] and the Ebon Vanguard. Players must visit all three of these races and attempt to gain allies against the Destroyer threat.

===[[Northern Allies]]===
Northern Allies starts off having you help Jora regain her reputation as a warrior and ability to "become the bear" - you must aid her in killing her brother, who was transformed into a monstrous [[Nornbear|Savage Nornbear]].  By using the wolf's blessing you track him down and kill him.  Then you must help her redeem herself by cleansing her ancestral family homestead from encroaching Charr. Players must also go and help [[Olaf Olafson]] cleanse the raven shrine - an important location to the Norn people.

===[[The Knowledgeable Asura]]===
You go with Vekk to seek out his people, the Asura, in order to help against the destroyers. You must rally some of the greatest Asuran minds in order to construct a Golem - a powerful magical creature that would be of great assistance in the war. Players find [[Oola]], [[Gadd]], and [[Renk]] to collaborate on the project. Players help defend the Golems as they are powered up, then take them to pillage a nearby Destroyer hive. For now, the Tarnished Coast will be out of peril.
[[File:Golem concept art 4.jpg|center|500px]]
===[[The Missing Vanguard]]===
Players go with Gwen to search for the missing Ebon Vanguard members, including their commander, [[Captain Langmar]]. You make a deal with a captive charr, [[Pyre Fierceshot]], who will help you find the Vanguard if you help him rescue his warband from the Shaman caste, which is now in open war with various rebellious Charr warbands , including Pyres. You later siege [[Hierophant Burntsoul]]'s stronghold, and rescue the Vanguard.

==Act III: [[A Time for Heroes]]==
Act III involves the second part of the Dwarf arc and the final battle against the Great Destroyer

It is discovered through the [[Scrying Pool]] that the destroyers come from an underground cavern near the [[Central Transfer Chamber]], and are being led by [[the Great Destroyer]]. In order to battle the destroyers successfully, the dwarves will need to summon the power of the [[Great Dwarf]], using an artifact from the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]]. Once alliances are made with the Asura, Norn, and Ebon Vanguard, the characters travel into the heart of the Shiverpeaks to recover the artifact, now guarded by [[Cyndr the Mountain Heart]], who the characters must battle. After returning the artifact, Jalis performs a ritual which changes most of the dwarves into [[Stone Dwarf|Stone Dwarves]], using the power of the Great Dwarf.

With all the allies prepared for the battle, the characters journey into a system of caverns leading to the [[Central Transfer Chamber]].  They are assisted throughout by Asuran [[Golem]]s, and at certain stages by the Stone Dwarves, Ebon Vanguard, and a group of five Norn.  When the characters reach the Central Transfer Chamber, they kill all the destroyers guarding it, including the [[Disc of Chaos]].
[[File:"Destroyer Dragon" concept art.jpg|left|200px]]
After conquering the Central Transfer Chamber, the characters realize that the battle has been costly for the dwarves and destroyers, and that continued fighting will likely wear the dwarves down, even with their new powers.  While discussing what to do, Gwen realizes that the Great Destroyer may be the "mind" for all of the destroyers, and that killing it will cause the lesser destroyers to lose coordination, and allow the dwarves to win the fight against them.  The Golems are left with the destroyers, and the characters travel into the nearby cavern to fight the Great Destroyer.  Although the Great Destroyer uses a number of powerful abilities and summons more lesser destroyers, it is defeated.

===[[Ogden's Benediction]]===
Killing the Great Destroyer had exactly the expected effect: the destroyers became confounded, and were beaten by the dwarves. Ogden also reveals that [[Livia]] found the [[Scepter of Orr]], a [[gw2:Sylvari|new type of creature]] is appearing, and that the "statue" in the Great Destroyer's cavern is actually alive, and will wake up some time in the future.

==Loose ends==
*Eye of the North ties up a number of loose ends and raises new questions.

===Answers===
*The [[Mursaat]] survived the conflict against the [[Titan]]s, however they have taken considerable losses.
*The Stone Summit are exiled after the destruction of [[Sorrow's Furnace]].
*The war between the charr and [[Ascalon]]ians wages on, as does the war between the [[White Mantle]] and the Shining Blade.

===Questions===
*What will become of the Dwarves? ([[gw2:The Movement of the World#Dwarves|Answer]])
*Was the creature defeated in A Time for Heroes the real [[the Great Destroyer|Great Destroyer]]? ([[Guild Wars Wiki:Projects/Unanswered questions/Lore#The Great Destroyer|Answer]])
**If so, what was the creature shown awakening at the end of the Ogden's Benediction cinematic? ([[Primordus|Answer]])
*What are the frozen creatures in [[Drakkar Lake]] and the colossal dragon-like creature in the [[Charr Homelands]]? (Answers [[gw2:Dragon champion|here]] and [[Elder Dragon|here]])
*What becomes of Pyre's revolution? ([[gw2:The Ecology of the Charr|Answer]])
*What becomes of the conflict between the Shining Blade and White Mantle? ([[War in Kryta|Answer]])
*[[Bahltek]] was added to Elonian areas not long before the release of ''Eye of the North''. What is his ''deal''?
